subject: HIPAA add-on econ: defer vs upfront split
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluepeakhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@bluepeakhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: HIPAA add-on pricing + evidence handling questions

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and audit sampling looked good. We
are working through procurement and have a few moving parts before we can sign:

- Audit log retention (7 yrs vs 1 yr) — how does that surface on the bill?
- KMS/HSM: is seat-based licensing available or only throughput-based?
- Evidence delivery: can you provide SOC2 artifacts + attestation timeline in the SOW?
- Credits: our finance team prefers amortizing onboarding costs over 12 months rather than an upfront implementation invoice.

Can you send a packaged pricing scenario that shows: (A) one-time implementation fee + recurring addon, (B) amortized credit against monthly invoices, and (C) a blended path where some portion is upfront and the rest amortized? Marcus and I need the numbers for our execs by Jan 18.

Appreciate it — attaching our procurement template separately.

Samantha
Director, IT Security
BluePeak Health

Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HIPAA add-on pricing + evidence handling questions

Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (pricing) and Aditya (security/compliance ops) to scope the paths and timing.

Quick answers up front:
- Retention tiers: we offer 1yr (base), 3yr, and 7yr (archival) with incremental storage/egress pricing; 7yr will add a modest per-GB/month line item — I'll put exact unit economics in the workbook.
- KMS/HSM: two options — managed keystore (throughput-based) or dedicated HSM seats (annual seat license). Seat pricing is amortizable per your ask.
- SOC2 artifacts: we can include a summary bundle in the SOW and commit to attestation delivery windows; full reports go under NDA/secure link.

I will send a workbook with scenarios A/B/C by EOD tomorrow (12th). If you prefer a short call early on the 13th to walk the spreadsheet, I can make time.

Best,
Evelyn
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: INTERNAL: BluePeak pricing scenarios workbook (draft)

Team — draft workbook attached (BP_compliance_pricing_workbook.xlsx). Notes:
- Scenario A (Upfront): Implementation fee $95k, recurring audit log tier + HSM seats; one-off revenue recognized at onboarding.
- Scenario B (Amortized): Convert $95k into a 12-month credit of $7,917/month applied as a contra-charge to recurring invoices; reduces ARR but smooths cashflow for customer.
- Scenario C (Blended): 50% upfront ($47.5k) + 6-month amortization for remainder ($7,917/mo over 6 months) — finance preferred for mid-size deals.

Pricing levers to confirm with Legal/RevOps: 1) whether credit amortization impacts SLA credits; 2) whether seat-license can be monthly or must be annual.

Also added sensitivity rows for retention at 1yr/3yr/7yr (storage + read-egress).

Ben
VP, Pricing & Finance (internal notes)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluepeakhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HIPAA add-on pricing + evidence handling questions

Samantha — quick operational clarifications from security/compliance:
- Evidence delivery cadence: standard turnaround for SOC2 attestation bundle is 7 business days after NDA + request; for deeper log copies (raw ingest) we need a scoped SOW and a 14-21 day window.
- Retention implementation: 7yr archival uses cold storage with restore fees; we'll document restore SLA and an estimate for one-time restore ops in the SOW.
- HSM seats: seats are annual by default due to provider licensing; we can do a 12-month seat amortization as Ben suggested, but month-to-month seats will increase effective unit cost by ~18%.

I'll add these operational notes into the SOW appendix. If BluePeak needs escrow access or an independent attestation for on-prem connectors, flag that now so we can price separately.

Thanks,
Aditya
Sr Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

--Attachment: SOC2-type2-summary.pdf (stated)

Evelyn / Ben / Aditya — this is very helpful, thanks. BluePeak prefers Scenario C (blended): 50% upfront, remainder amortized (6 months) — that aligns with our CFO guidance. Two small asks before we go to legal:

1) Can you reflect the 7yr archival restore fee as a capped line item (max $5k per restore event) and include that cap language in the SOW?
2) Please provide a DocuSign-ready term sheet (we will route to procurement) and the SOW appendix with the evidence delivery timelines called out explicitly (7 business days for attestation; 14–21 for raw log retrieval).

If you can get the term sheet + DocuSign link to me by EOD Wednesday (Jan 20), we'll push to legal immediately.

Marcus and I are looped on procurement; once legal thumbs up, we expect signature within two weeks.

Thanks again — looking forward to closing this.

Samantha

BluePeak Health
